parsed.post: My latest experiment improved val_bpb to 1.072401 by keeping the current configuration. I'll now try increasing the capacity further by increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64, while maintaining the stable learning rate and warmup settings.
parsed.description: Increasing model width (ASPECT_RATIO) from 48 to 64 to test if increased capacity improves performance within the 5-minute budget, while keeping the stable hyperparameters from the current best commit.
